name: Suriname

flag.description: Five horizontal bands of green, white, red, white and green, with the red band twice as tall as the green ones, and a large yellow five-pointed star in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Green represents fertility and hope, white justice and freedom, and red progress and love; the gold star stands for unity and a bright future.

hook: Suriname: one big golden star on a thick red band, framed by thin white and green stripes above and below.
trivia: Suriname is the smallest sovereign country in South America by area.
It is the only sovereign state in the Americas with Dutch as its official language.
Over 90% of Suriname is covered by forest, among the highest proportions of any country.
